cover.coreProposition: Long-lived memory should make evidence harder to mutate than interpretation by separating immutable observations, relation decisions, active retrieval views, and recoverable evidence history.
cover.visualMetaphor: Immutable crystal fragments remain visible beneath a flowing violet surface that reshapes around them.
cover.semanticObject: Stable cyan crystal evidence beneath a mutable violet glass layer
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with deep navy depth, preserved cyan fragments, a flowing violet layer, one restrained amber highlight, and generous negative space
